name: When should I consider replacing my metal roof instead of repairing a leak?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my metal roof instead of repairing a leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your metal roof rather than just repairing a leak if the leak is a symptom of widespread issues, such as extensive corrosion, multiple damaged panels, or structural deterioration that compromises the roof's overall integrity. A single, isolated leak on an otherwise sound roof can often be repaired. However, if leaks are frequent, widespread, or due to a systemic failure, replacement offers a more durable and long-term solution. Our team can help you determine the underlying cause.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacement if a leak signifies widespread issues like extensive corrosion or structural damage, rather than an isolated problem. Frequent or systemic leaks usually warrant a new roof.
